entries.zh: 冷水，凉如铁的水；使水冷却
entries.en: cold water, water (made) cold as iron; to cool water
entries.notes: 西语栏 venel agua 书写含混（疑为 en el agua 连写），闽南语原稿栏读音与汉字'冷水'及官话对音 lèng chùi 不密合；释义以汉字与西语 enfriar el agua 为据。

entries.en: to deceive, to cheat
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注[疑:騗/騙]，两形皆训欺骗，与西语 Engañar 及读音 piēn 相合；释义定'欺骗'，字形存疑。

entries.en: to deceive; to beguile, keep (someone) in the dark
to deceive, to delude; to lie to

entries.zh: 设诡计哄骗；以巧计纠缠欺诈
entries.en: to deceive with wiles/tricks; to ensnare by deceit
entries.notes: 汉字栏'需'与西语 engañar con enredos（以诡计纠缠哄骗）语义不合，闽南语原稿栏又混写西文 con enredos；释义依西语栏，汉字存疑。

entries.zh: 欺骗；卷携他人财物潜逃
entries.en: to deceive; to abscond with another's property
entries.notes: 西语栏 al carse conlo ageno 即 alzarse con lo ajeno（卷逃他人财物）；汉字栏'末'与此不合而读音 boā 近'瞒'，恐为误读，释义依西语。

entries.zh: 欺骗；说谎（背，指背后欺瞒）
entries.en: to deceive; to lie
entries.notes: 汉字'背'取'背叛/背后欺瞒'义以合西语 engañar, mentir，字义对合较间接。

entries.en: to deceive; to delude, keep in ignorance
to delude, lead astray
entries.notes: 闽南语原稿栏 bēy pabechái 中 pabechái 一段无以对应（或为别字混写）；据'迷'与西语 engañar 定'迷惑'义。

entries.zh: 以好话哄骗；煽惑（花言巧语骗人）
entries.en: to deceive with fine words; to wheedle
entries.notes: 汉字'煽'取'煽惑'义以合西语 engañar con buenos palabras；闽南语栏读音 siēn 与官话对音 piēn 相左，释义以汉字与西语为据。

entries.en: to entice away, abduct (children or pregnant women)
to bewilder, beguile
to defraud, cheat (an elder deceiving a junior)
entries.notes: 闽南语原稿栏三音节 cung coy giēn 与单字'詐'难合（或含他字），官话对音 kùàng 合'詐'；释义据西语 engañar el mayor a el menor 与汉字'詐'。

entries.zh: 受坏女人所骗；与恶妇纠葛而被哄骗
entries.en: to be duped by, to be led astray with a bad woman
entries.notes: 汉字栏'拆'与西语 engañar con la mala mujer 语义不合，读音 chwa/chūe 亦难对应；释义依西语栏，汉字存疑。

entries.en: cunning, crafty; a deceiver, trickster
entries.notes: 汉字'狡'训狡诈且读音 cau 合之，官话对音 guian 相左；西语栏兼含动词 engañar 与名词 engañador，释义两存。

entries.zh: 冒认，误认（语言上认错听错而自误）
entries.en: to be mistaken (in language); to misrecognize

entries.zh: 瞒生人目——瞒过生人（活人）的眼睛；指丧事中瞒骗亲族、照看亡者
entries.en: to deceive the eyes of the living; (in funeral custom) deceiving the relatives while tending the dead
entries.notes: 西语栏句末破折号示词条接下页；'瞒生人目'为丧俗习语，与西语 engañar los parientes y cuidan de el muerto 描述相合。

entries.zh: 瞒人目——蒙骗人的眼睛（做假遮人眼目）
entries.en: to deceive people's eyes; to hoodwink (make a show to fool the eye)
to conceal and deceive; to hoodwink
to cheat, swindle; fraud by deceit

entries.zh: 拐带——拐骗携走（拐人而去）
entries.en: to entice away and carry off (a person); abduction by deceit
